description: Clean Energy Regulator reports and data is a data repository run by Clean Energy Regulator, Australia. The regulator publishes registers and data of accredited power stations, small-scale solar installations by postcode, large-scale generation certificates and emissions reporting, as spreadsheets and CSV. Coverage: Australia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as xlsx, csv; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Reports and data | Clean Energy Regulator") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support generation and rooftop-solar capacity studies of Australia. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
